name: HYLQ Strategy Corp.
summary: Operating as an investment holding company, HYLQ Strategy Corp. is dedicated to deploying capital across a diverse range of promising industries. Its strategic focus encompasses sectors such as longevity, blockchain and cryptocurrency, gambling, gaming, affiliate ventures, financial technology (fintech), energy technology, e-commerce, and retail. The corporation previously operated under the name Tony G Co-Investment Holdings Ltd. before rebranding to HYLQ Strategy Corp. in June 2025. Its principal office is situated in Mississauga, Canada.
